purpose: apples-to-apples stock versus durable step-8 adapter comparison after stratified fast-dev fix

quality_gate_replay.note: Replayed locally against the downloaded raw v23 outputs; the gate is conservative and does not replace expert review. Both candidates are vetoed identically.

interpretation: The adapter is numerically neutral at step 8: no MCQA gain and only a 0.002897 lower SFT dev loss.
The earlier v21 one-SFT-row result was an invalid comparison for generation quality; the corrected stratified evaluator includes 14 SFT rows.
Both stock and adapter share the held-out generation weaknesses: short 64-token caps, missing dispositions, false-premise acceptance, and incoherent language on several Swahili prompts.
The durable adapter is not a candidate, but the run does not prove that the training recipe caused the shared baseline behavior.
decision: Do not export or promote the step-8 adapter. Keep the checkpoint for resume/infrastructure testing. Before another training run, improve the stock-prompt/decode baseline and add generation-quality veto metrics to checkpoint selection.
